name: kanopi/firewall
description: Evaluate the requests for malicious items.

suggest.ext-redis: Required only by Kanopi\Firewall\RateLimitStorage\RedisRateLimitStorage, for distributed rate limiting. Every other rate-limit backend (memory, file, database, PSR-6 cache) works without it.

perf:quick: PERF_VUS=50 PERF_DURATION=15s PERF_RAMP=5s PERF_WARMUP=5 bash tests/Performance/bin/run.sh baseline bootstrap crs all-on

scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites without coverage — the fast loop for local development
scripts-descriptions.phpunit:coverage: Run both suites in a single pass with coverage. Coverage MUST be measured across both suites: running them separately leaves integration tests out of the figure entirely, which understated Firewall.php by 20 percentage points
scripts-descriptions.test:gate: Alias for phpunit:coverage — the run the CI coverage gate reads
scripts-descriptions.demo: Run the demo on PHP's built-in server (single-process) at http://localhost:8000
scripts-descriptions.demo:workers: Same as `demo` but with PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS=8 for concurrent request handling
scripts-descriptions.demo:reset: Delete the demo's FileStorage data file (/tmp/firewall-demo.data) so the next request starts with a clean slate
scripts-descriptions.demo:perf: Run the production-shaped demo stack (nginx + php-fpm) at http://localhost:8000
scripts-descriptions.demo:perf:down: Tear down the nginx + php-fpm demo stack
scripts-descriptions.demo:perf:restart: Restart only the php-fpm container (handy when opcache holds stale bytecode after edits)
scripts-descriptions.perf: Run the full per-plugin performance benchmark (nginx + php-fpm + k6, ~20-40 min). Results in tests/Performance/results/
scripts-descriptions.perf:quick: Short benchmark over baseline, bootstrap, crs and all-on — enough to sanity check a change in a couple of minutes
scripts-descriptions.perf:validate: Check every performance scenario config loads and evaluates, in seconds. Run this before a full benchmark
scripts-descriptions.perf:down: Tear down the performance harness stack and drop its volumes (GeoIP databases and caches)
scripts-descriptions.log:prune: Delete firewall log rows older than the handler's retention_days. Pass options after `--`, e.g. `composer log:prune -- firewall.yml --dry-run`
scripts-descriptions.check:request: Ask whether a given request would be blocked, and by what. Pass options after `--`, e.g. `composer check:request -- --config=firewall.yml --ip=203.0.113.5 --url=/wp-admin/`
